name: raise the depth limit and restart
mechanism: run a depth-limited search, and if it fails increase the limit by one and start again from scratch, so memory stays linear while the order found is breadth-like

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Iterative deepening depth-first search (IDDFS)' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: a state space search strategy

fails_when: repeats shallow work each round (a constant factor)
